name: Yuuki
source:
The other male that is the same age as [url=/c681]Kai[/url]. Came to the mansion before Kai, and showed him around when he was still not familiar with the place. Gentle, doesn’t seem very dependable but at heart a good guy, the best friend character…or so his setting was at the start. Really a sarcastic, bored, smarty pants that loves his pranks.

[Edited and taken from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/12/04/midori-no-umi-review/]Warum's review[/url].]
